protocol: 50 claims sampled seed-17 from 602 live post-veto rows (10 shards, 200 HF model cards); graded by the session model vs the FULL card_md plus the registry metadata fields, BEFORE ingest/scoring; labels frozen at write time. DEFECT threshold identical to arxivai50 (D92): (a) asserts what the source does not — inferred, absent, or contradicted; (b) drops a condition/qualifier that changes truth conditions; (c) the subject is not the model (extraction artifact). NOT defects: awkward phrasing, kind-field mislabels, 'The card states' without the model name (page provenance resolves it).
claim_mix_warning: This precision is NOT comparable to the abstract audits without the split below: registry claims are copied from metadata FIELDS and are mechanically verifiable, so they are near-free. 15/50 sampled claims are registry claims and 0 of them are defective; card-CONTENT precision is the number to compare against arxivai50's 0.82.

defect_notes.1: 'reports accuracy of 0.9700' — metric value with NO benchmark/dataset named; uninterpretable as stored (rule 4)
defect_notes.41: 'describes using Transformer-based models' — 'Transformer-based' appears nowhere in the card; vacuous and inferred from background knowledge (rule 1)
defect_notes.44: subject is 'The load tagger' — lifted from a Python comment '# load tagger' in the usage snippet, not the model (flair/ner-english); names a model that does not exist

borderlines_resolved_precise.17_20: 'card indicates a model size of 149M/395M' — the size comes from the model NAME, not a stated parameter count; the hedged verb 'indicates' matches that evidential strength
borderlines_resolved_precise.8: 'The card states...' without naming the model — same exemption as arxivai50's 'The paper achieves X'
borderlines_resolved_precise.42: card's own Uses section says 'text classification' while pipeline_tag says zero-shot-classification; registry field is a legitimate source per rule 5
borderlines_resolved_precise.30: 'used for training or evaluation' — a vague disjunction, but accurate
borderlines_resolved_precise.34: 'lists transformers.js as a characteristic' — awkward, but it IS a card tag
